title.en: Zu Chongzhi: mathematics, calendars and court debate
title.zh: 祖冲之：数学、历法与朝廷争论

labelI18n.zh: 建康，代表性的朝廷地点

summary.en:
Zu Chongzhi worked on mathematical and astronomical problems in the southern dynasties. His Daming calendar proposed a 391-year cycle containing 144 intercalary months; its submission at court led to a dispute over observation and inherited practice. The calendar was not adopted during Emperor Xiaowu’s lifetime.

Later accounts also associate Zu with accurate approximations to pi, including 355/113, and with mechanical devices. His mathematical treatise survives through later descriptions rather than as a complete text, so the precise method behind the calculation cannot be reconstructed with confidence.
summary.zh:
祖冲之在南朝研究数学与天文历法。他提出的大明历采用391年144闰月的周期，上奏后引发朝廷对于观测与旧制的争论；孝武帝在世时该历未获施行。

后世记载还将圆周率的精密近似值，包括355/113，以及机械制作与祖冲之联系起来。他的数学著作并未完整传世，现存转述不足以可靠还原具体计算方法。

dateNote.en: Born 429. The Book of Southern Qi dates his death to Yongyuan 2 (500); the University of St Andrews gives 501. The 478 pin represents the 477–479 Shengming era, not an exact year.
dateNote.zh: 生于429年。《南齐书》记其卒于永元二年（500）；圣安德鲁斯大学资料列为501年。地图中的478年节点代表477—479年的升明年间，不是确定的具体年份。

sources.title: Zu Chongzhi biography
sources.publisher: University of St Andrews, MacTutor History of Mathematics
sources.evidenceNote: Life, Daming calendar proposal in 462 and approximations to pi; the biography gives death as 501. Its conjecture about the calculation method is not treated as established.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 生平、462年大明历提案与圆周率近似值；该传记列卒年为501年。有关计算方法的推测不视为定论。

sources.title: Book of Song, volume 13: calendar treatise
sources.evidenceNote: Retrospective calendar treatise records the Daming year-six submission, its 391-year and 144-intercalation cycle, and a court debate.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 后出的历志记载大明六年上奏、391年144闰的历法周期及朝廷争论。

sources.title: Book of Southern Qi, volume 52: Zu Chongzhi
sources.evidenceNote: Retrospective biography describes the calendar dispute, a south-pointing carriage in the Shengming era, and death in Yongyuan year two. It does not establish an exact death place.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 后出的传记叙述历法争论、升明年间的指南车，以及永元二年去世；未确立具体去世地点。

expansion.sourceReview: Independently written bilingual synthesis from inspected dynastic histories and university scholarship; upstream profile was a research lead.

reviewLimit.en: Court histories were compiled later. Approximate locations are contexts, not a reconstructed itinerary; the two sources differ on the death year.
reviewLimit.zh: 朝代史书均为后出记述。近似地点是背景而非复原行程；两个来源的卒年不同。

en: The Daming calendar prompted an argument over astronomical methods and inherited practice.
Later accounts preserve precise approximations to pi, while his calculation method remains uncertain.
zh: 大明历引发有关天文方法与旧制的争论。
后世记载保存了精密的圆周率近似值，但具体计算方法仍不明确。

description.en: The court received Zu’s proposal for a calendar with 144 intercalary months in 391 years; surviving accounts record a dispute over its merits.
description.zh: 祖冲之向朝廷呈上391年144闰的大明历；传世记载记录了关于其优劣的争论。

title.en: Yelü Chucai: service across the Jin and Mongol courts
title.zh: 耶律楚材：金与蒙古朝廷之间的仕途

labelI18n.zh: 中都，金朝都城的代表性地点

summary.en:
A Khitan scholar-official, Yelü Chucai served under the Jin and later under the Mongol rulers Chinggis Khan and Ögedei. His life crossed the fall of Zhongdu, the Mongol campaigns in Central Asia and efforts to organize taxation in northern China. The History of Yuan presents his advice and administrative role from a later court perspective; it should not be read as proof that he acted alone or prevented all violence.

His account of western places offers evidence of Mongol-era knowledge, but a modern study cautions that it is not a complete, stop-by-stop itinerary. The atlas therefore shows selected contexts rather than a reconstructed journey.
summary.zh:
契丹士人耶律楚材先后服务于金朝及蒙古统治者成吉思汗、窝阔台。他的人生经历中都陷落、蒙古在中亚的军事行动，以及华北税收制度的整顿。《元史》从后世朝廷视角记述他的建议和行政角色，不能据此认定一切成果由他独力完成，也不能推称他阻止了所有暴行。

他记述西方地域的著作反映蒙古时代的知识；现代研究提醒，这并非逐站完整行程。因此地图只呈现选取的历史背景，不复原行军路线。

dateNote.en: 1190–1244. The 1218 summons and 1231 fiscal episode are dated by the cited study and the cyclical year in the Yuan history. Map points represent documented settings or departure context; the summons site is not fixed.
dateNote.zh: 1190—1244年。1218年受召及1231年赋税事迹分别依据所引研究和《元史》干支纪年。地图点代表有记载的背景或出发区域；受召地点未确定。

sources.title: Journeys to the West: Yelü Chucai and his account
sources.evidenceNote: Scholarly account dates the fall of Zhongdu and the 1218 summons; it warns that the western account is not a complete itinerary.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 学术研究说明中都陷落与1218年受召，并指出西行记述不是完整行程。

sources.title: History of Yuan, volume 146: Yelü Chucai
sources.evidenceNote: Later court biography describes service, tax registers at Yunzhong in a xinmao year, and death in a jiachen year; cyclical years are read as 1231 and 1244 in this sequence.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 后出的朝廷传记记述其仕途、辛卯年在云中呈报赋税簿籍及甲辰年去世；此处按前后次序将干支换算为1231年和1244年。

expansion.sourceReview: Independently written bilingual synthesis of an inspected university study and dynastic biography; upstream profile was a research lead.

reviewLimit.en: The Yuan biography is retrospective and court-centered; the western account does not establish a complete route. Fiscal administration was collective.
reviewLimit.zh: 《元史》传记为后出、以朝廷为中心的记述；西行记述不能确立完整路线。赋税行政由多方共同完成。

en: His career joined a Jin court background to Mongol rule.
The western account is evidence of knowledge and travel, not a complete itinerary.
zh: 他的仕途连接金朝背景与蒙古统治。
西行记述是知识与旅行的证据，并非完整行程。

description.en: The Mongols took Zhongdu, the former Jin capital. Yelü, a Jin official, remained in the region before later entering Mongol service.
description.zh: 蒙古军攻取金朝旧都中都。曾为金朝官员的耶律楚材其后留在这一地区，后来进入蒙古官府任职。

description.en: After a period of retirement, Yelü was summoned in spring 1218 and traveled toward the steppe. The pin represents his departure region, not a verified meeting point.
description.zh: 隐居一段时间后，耶律楚材于1218年春受召，向草原方向行进。地图点代表出发区域，并非已证实的会见地点。

location.label: Former Zhongdu area; departure context only

labelI18n.en: Former Zhongdu area; departure context only
labelI18n.zh: 中都旧址一带，仅代表出发背景

description.en: The History of Yuan places the presentation of tax registers to Ögedei at Yunzhong in a xinmao year, corresponding here to 1231. The account describes one part of a wider administrative effort.
description.zh: 《元史》记载在辛卯年于云中向窝阔台呈报赋税簿籍，此处对应1231年。这一记述只是更广泛行政工作的一个侧面。

labelI18n.zh: 云中，今大同一带的代表性地点
